title: Parallel Non-Integer Multiple-Cell-Height Node Remapping
extraction_scope: NTU publication title, four authors, DOI and abstract; not manuscript or thesis extraction.
mechanism: Timing-critical node remapping uses parallel longest-path-first and iterative minimum-slack-first schemes to reduce enumeration overhead in non-integer multiple-cell-height designs.
reported_claim: Average remapping runtime speedup 5.58x with placement quality preserved; abstract-level author claim only.
limits: Named baseline, benchmark circuits, thread count, machine and placement-quality tolerances are not established by this abstract.
Remapping runtime is not full design-flow runtime or fabricated-chip performance.
A similarly titled thesis is not automatically the conference manuscript.
